event_key.description: Calendar occurrence key. Creates a meeting with its title, start, attendee names and sensitivity. Unknown keys are refused; incompatible with conversation entries or append_to. Event captures never deduplicate.

kind.description: Source kind: video, meeting, chat, email, doc, receipt, bill, conversation or note. Inferred as video for video uploads or doc for document uploads when absent.

title.description: Source title; defaults to the upload file name or first text line. In session mode, crew proposal (at most eight words) or user title with title_by: user. Private sessions use the first user line for scribe titles.

text.description: Pasted text, or the single entry text with entry_kind.

upload_path.description: Path of an uploaded file inside the allowed roots (workspace or Library). The original is copied and pinned by sha256. HTML, docx, pptx, PDF, Markdown and text are converted to anchorable text; document input is limited to 32 MiB.

append_to.description: Conversation source id to append entries to. One Library commit per append; earlier lines never change.

entries.description: Entries as {kind,text} or "<kind>: <text>"; kinds: decision, direction, fact, action, open, resolved, handoff, correction. Aliases type/message/content are accepted. For a correction, append {kind:"correction",correction:{anchor:"#L1",choice:"not_decision"|"kind"|"wording"|"remove",kind?:<new kind>,text?:<new wording>}} to an existing source. A JSON correction string in text is also accepted. User additions use {kind:"direction"|"decision"|"fact",text:<verbatim>,by:"user"}; by records attribution, not authenticated identity. Corrections require append_to; missing targets and malformed choices refuse the complete batch.

entry_kind.description: Kind for a single entry given as text.

transcript_path.description: Path of a .vtt transcript for a video upload, inside the allowed roots. Imported as #t= turns with no model call.

origin.description: Free-text origin, for example Slack #pricing, pasted.

sensitivity.description: normal or private; defaults from Library settings for the kind.

tags.description: Source tags, such as bootstrap:orientation. Stored in frontmatter, merged on dedupe or append, and filterable through office.search tag.

captured_by.description: upload, paste, routine or orchestrator; inferred when absent.

session_transcript_path.description: Contained Claude Code JSONL session transcript (8 MiB maximum); separate from WebVTT transcript_path. Used only with session_id and transcript extraction fields.

session_id.description: Expected sessionId in the transcript, used as the stable source identity.

transcript_preview.description: Return scrubbed numbered evidence lines without creating a source. Private content is withheld.

from_line.description: Session mode only: first line (zero-based, inclusive) an incremental preview or pass considers. Preview also returns at most one earlier assistant line marked context: true; selecting a line before from_line is refused.

transcript_sha256.description: Preview digest, required with selections; changed input is refused.

answers.description: Zero-based assistant question line this user reply answers. The reply becomes a decision only when the adapter's answer checks pass (the question is the line just before the reply and ends in ?, the reply is unhedged and an affirmative or negative to a yes/no question or an offered option label); otherwise it is open. Both lines are copied verbatim.

selections.description: Cheap crew evidence choices by line number; quotes are copied by the adapter, and uncertain/non-user decisions become open unless answers passes the answer checks. Without selections classification is conservative.

handoff.description: Session mode with selections only: a scribe handoff of at most 60 words, written as a handoff entry marked (scribe) when the dom-scribe-rules page sets scribe.handoff: true. It must cite at least one #L<n> body anchor of the source after this pass's entries, each naming a log entry, and the pass must add a decision, direction or action; otherwise it is dropped and the other entries still land.

project.description: Session start working directory supplied by hook when transcript cwd is absent.

branch.description: Session start branch supplied by hook when transcript gitBranch is absent.

repository.description: Session mode only: known GitHub owner/repo for unqualified PR numbers; inferred from a GitHub project URL or owner/repo project when possible.

resume.description: Session mode only: display-only resume target; defaults to claude --resume <session-id>.

title_by.description: Session mode only, with title: scribe (default) or user. Scribe titles have at most eight words; a user title is never replaced by a scribe.
